title: Expert says the latest UFO file dump lacks conclusive data
description:
The Trump administration on Friday released a seventh tranche of provocative UFO files, but to Avi Loeb, a UAP researcher with ties to the White House, it’s another collection of reports that lack definitive data for scientists to draw conclusions. Once again, he notes, there’s no firm answer about whether the U.S. government or contractors have recovered suspected alien tech. “If it exists, my plea to whoever owns them is: Please, take me to the nearest alien spacecraft because I could help you figure this out,” Loeb tells “The Hill.”
